title: Heat Pumps | Mass Save
summary: Mass Save program page promoting heat pumps: heating and cooling in one, cold-climate efficiency, weatherization first, seasonal heat pump rate.

assertions.quote: Heat pumps can efficiently heat in the winter and double as a cooling system in the summer
Today’s cold climate heat pumps are 2-3x as efficient as a boiler or furnace
many provide efficient heat at outdoor temperatures as low as -15 °F
Heat pumps have the lowest carbon emissions of any heating source.
Heat pumps require minimal maintenance and can eliminate the hassle of scheduling fuel deliveries.
Before upgrading your heating system, consider preliminary measures, such as sealing and insulating your ductwork or completing weatherization work.
In many cases, that additional electrical use is offset by savings elsewhere, such as a propane or oil heating fuel bill.
Seasonal Heat Pump Rate, which offers lower electric rates from November through April to help make heat pump operation more affordable.
